manifest.note: Lightweight source-verified sentinels for the angels-pizza generalization target. Root revisions are pinned by content digest in truth-set/targets.json (no VCS). Draft, pending human sign-off. Paths are relative to each named root under ~/Documents/angels-pizza.

items.claim: The Node backend is an Express app mounting its HTTP API under /api, with route modules under routes/ (auth, cart, checkout, ...).

evidence.note: route modules: auth, cart, categories, checkout, contact, ...

items.prevents: Missing the backend's HTTP surface entirely (Express is reader-covered; this is the baseline positive).

items.claim: web-vue declares a client route table via vue-router (createRouter) with paths /, /product/:id, /new-page, /checkout.
items.prevents: Reporting web-vue as having no routes or no structure because no dedicated Vue Router reader exists — the generic path must surface this router config.

items.claim: web-vue calls the backend HTTP API through a configured base URL (VITE_API_BASE_URL / VITE_API_URL).
items.prevents: Missing the frontend to backend API boundary — a key cross-boundary relation.

items.claim: web-vue's vue-router paths are CLIENT routes; they are not server-side HTTP endpoints and must not be attributed as backend API routes.

evidence.note: import { createRouter } from 'vue-router' — client router, not an HTTP server

items.prevents: Mis-attributing Vue client routes as backend HTTP endpoints (a precision false positive).

items.claim: web-vue defines no server-side HTTP route handlers — it is a Vue SPA; there is no Express/server router in it.

evidence.note: no Express app / server route registration under src; routing is client-side vue-router only

items.prevents: Fabricating backend HTTP endpoints for a client-only SPA (a false-positive 'has server routes' conclusion).

items.claim: web-vue has Vue views and components as structural units under src/views and src/components.
items.prevents: Producing no structural result for Vue source (an empty-structure false negative on the no-reader path).
